chapters.title: 先放中心，还没有决定谁属于谁
chapters.en: Start with centers before assigning observations.

chapters.title: 先按最近中心分组
chapters.en: Assign each observation to its nearest center.

chapters.title: 再把中心移到组内平均位置
chapters.en: Move each center to its assigned cluster mean.
